data.completion_memo: Two follow-up fixes to the Chat output filter. (1) Empty Agent blocks: extracted the model-call channel helpers into a pure `modelCallChannels.ts` (`isModelCallSpan`, `modelCallAssistantOutput`, new `modelCallReasoning`) and taught `filterTimelineItems` that a model-call span is not a standalone thinking entry: it is never dropped by the `kind === "thinking"` rule (a reasoning-bearing model-call span is projected as `kind: "thinking"` and also carries the final answer), and it is dropped whole only when its reasoning was its entire human-readable content (reasoning present, assistant output empty). This removes the blocks the user saw and also fixes a latent bug where the kind rule alone could have removed a model-call span together with its answer. (2) On-demand loading under the filter: `useOlderChatEvents` now takes the same `filterItems` predicate the transcript uses and applies it to both the previously visible feed and each candidate page, so its "did we gain earlier activity?" loop keeps fetching while the filter hides the pages; `useChatRuntime` gained an optional third `filterItems` parameter (default identity) and `ChatWorkspaceScreen` passes its `outputFilter`-derived predicate. Verified: `pnpm check` clean; `pnpm build` (`tsc --noEmit && vite build`) succeeds; new/updated tests pass — `chatOutputFilter.test.ts` (5, incl. keep-answer/drop-empty model call), `ModelCallBlock.test.tsx` (6), `eventWindow.test.tsx` (5, incl. a new test proving the loader reads a second page only when tools are hidden: calls 1 vs 2), `ChatOutputFilterControl.test.tsx` (2); and the whole `pnpm test:chat` suite (46 files, 296 tests) passes. A repo-wide case-insensitive stem scan is clean.

lines:
Feature: a filter icon button at the top of the Chat opens a dropdown with a checkbox per entry — `thinking` and `tools`. Unchecked entries are not displayed; toggling must update already-rendered content; with both unchecked only user input and model output remain.
Implementation notes (researched): render pipeline is `timelineItems` (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:241-244`, must stay unfiltered for the question dialog / Run Details at 932) → `feedItems` (245) → `ConversationTimeline` → `presentTimelineItems` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:65). Classification: standalone reasoning is `kind==="thinking"` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:499); tool/MCP are `kind==="tool"` (523) / `kind==="mcp"` (generic card). Crucially a model-call span with streamed reasoning is rendered by `ModelCallBlock` (255) which contains the reasoning bubble *and* the final assistant answer, so a naive `kind` filter would delete the answer — thread a `hideThinking` prop into `ModelCallBlock` instead and hide only its reasoning bubble. Add the control to `.run-actions` in the Chat header (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:715`), reusing the `TodoControl` popover pattern (outside-click/Escape close, aria-expanded/controls). No production localStorage exists, so keep the filter in React state (session-scoped).
Verification: extend `ModelCallBlock.test.tsx` / timeline tests for hiding thinking inside a model call and hiding tool rows, and assert the user message + assistant answer remain.

data.title: Add a Chat output filter for reasoning (thinking) and tool entries
